claims.claim: In resolveBusinessPKForMaster, if resolveConflictTarget returns a column other than _gpay_id it returns that column; otherwise for non-flatten bindings it checks candidates binding.SourcePK, _id, id, and _source_id against colTypes.

In TransmuterModule.Run and processBatch, a deleted Shadow row SourceID is appended to deletedInShadow or localDeleteSourceIDs only when !activeSourceIDs[row.SourceID], and bulkUpsertMaster includes OR COALESCE(master._gpay_id, 0) <> COALESCE(EXCLUDED._gpay_id, 0) in ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE WHERE.

In ExecuteHealHandler.publishTransmuteShadowForSegA, shadow_connection_key is set to default, and in executeHealSegB, effectivePruneIDType auto-detects gpay for numeric IDs and checks Shadow for active rows before deleting from Master.

In TestNATSMonitorHandler_GetOverview_AutoHealsMissingCoreStreamsOnRealNATS and TestNatsClient_EnsureStreams_PreservesExistingCDCEventsSubjects, the tests call EnsureStreams and verify StreamInfo without calling DeleteStream on CDC_TRANSMUTE, CDC_EVENTS, SCHEMA_DRIFT, or SCHEMA_CONFIG.
